patch: R4 round 2 — PanicDial specialist (family 1: centroid readout + emulated bias; calibration regularised vs round 1)
directions: mu, class means, D, mhat, bias_centered computed from DIAGNOSTIC split ONLY (probe.npz hidden states, base model, answer position). Identical geometry to round 1 (same directions.npz).
formula: Delta_c = 0.20*D_c + 0.10*bias_centered_c*m_hat + gamma_c*m_hat, gamma = gamma_full + gamma_sim + 0.5*gamma_resid (round 1: full gamma_resid).

edits.label: calm
edits.value: coeff * D_calm from directions.npz (diagnostic class-mean hidden state minus global mean)
edits.mechanism: Delta += 0.2 * D_calm on row 19300 (' calm') of BOTH tied copies. Identical to round 1: round 2's dose experiments (dir 0.25/0.30 real-model collapse via input-coupling distortion; dir 0.15 generation collapse) showed round 1's dose is the real-model operating point — see R4-ROUND2.md.

edits.label: calm
edits.mechanism: Delta += 0.306424 * m_hat (scale*bias_centered_calm at scale=0.10, identical to round 1; bias_centered=3.0642 = -||mu_calm||^2/||mu|| centred) on row 19300 of BOTH copies. Emulates the -||mu_c||^2 term of the nearest-centroid classifier as an effective per-class bias, since h.m_hat = 184.39 +/- 2.56 is near-constant.

edits.label: calm
edits.mechanism: Delta += gamma_calm * m_hat (gamma=0.00065063) on row 19300 of BOTH copies. THE round-2 change: gamma = gamma_full + gamma_sim + 0.5*gamma_resid (round 1 used the full residual correction). Halving the fixed-point residual correction — the most diagnostic-fitted component, worth +5.0 diagnostic argmax points in round 1's record — regularises the calibration toward the raw class-mean geometry. Decomposition in EXPLANATION.md.
